rules.sentence: Recall that the characteristic features of IBP include age of onset less than 40, back pain duration exceeding 3 months, insidious onset, morning stiffness, and improvement with exercise.
It is crucial to exclude pain sources stemming from cancer or vertebral body compression fractures.
